# Hannah Goldy

> UFC veteran, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu black belt and NASM Certified Personal Trainer. She coaches in person in Orlando, Florida and Dallas, Texas, and online anywhere.

Hannah has trained in MMA for over twelve years, ten of them professionally, including in the UFC. She has had hypothyroidism since age ten, and after having her son she went from 180 pounds to 115 and was back competing six months later.

## Ways to work with Hannah

- [Personal training](https://hannahgoldy.com/training): one-on-one training in Orlando and Dallas, online coaching anywhere, private jiu-jitsu and MMA lessons, and seminars and group training in self-defense, jiu-jitsu and MMA (travel available). The first call is free. Prices are discussed on the call.
- [Personal trainer in Orlando](https://hannahgoldy.com/personal-trainer-orlando): in-person one-on-one training around Orlando, including Orange, Seminole, Osceola and Lake counties.
- [Personal trainer in Dallas](https://hannahgoldy.com/personal-trainer-dallas): in-person one-on-one training around Dallas, including Dallas, Collin, Denton and Tarrant counties.
- [Private jiu-jitsu and MMA](https://hannahgoldy.com/private-jiu-jitsu-mma): private lessons in Orlando and Dallas with a BJJ black belt and UFC veteran, any experience level.
- [Self-defense seminars](https://hannahgoldy.com/self-defense-seminars): self-defense, jiu-jitsu and MMA seminars for gyms, groups and organizations. Travel available.
- [The Goldy Standard](https://hannahgoldy.com/program/): Hannah's 12-week training program with three tracks: Fat Loss, Build Muscle and Fighter Conditioning.
